ROOT-Blends.description: The `Blends.txt` file is used in the [mapping tools](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Mapping#Mapping_tools) to assign blend tiles around the tiles you paint.
ROOT-Blends.name: ROOT-Blends

ROOT-Default.description: The default.txt file is used to select the mods and maps that will be loaded by the game.
ROOT-Default.name: ROOT-Default

version.description: The version of the default.txt file. Keep it at 1.
version.name: VERSION

ROOT-MapBaseXML.description: The `MapBaseXML.txt` file is used to configure the layers of the TMX file.
ROOT-MapBaseXML.name: ROOT-MapBaseXML

ROOT-MapInfo.description:
The `map.info` file is used to define the map's information. It is used by the game to display the map in the map selection screen and to load the map into the world.

It needs to be located in:
```
📁 media
  📁 maps
    📁 <map folder>
      📄 map.info
```
ROOT-MapInfo.name: ROOT-MapInfo

demovideo.description: [Video file](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/File_formats#Video_format) used to showcase the map when selecting it.
demovideo.name: demoVideo

fixed2x.description: Boolean which fixes rendering issues. Leave it as `true` if you are not sure.
fixed2x.name: fixed2x

lots.description: Refers to the world map the map will be loaded into. For a map which is inside the vanilla world map, use `lots=Muldraugh, KY`.
lots.name: lots

zooms.description: Zoom parameter used to define the position of the camera on the world map when chosing the map to spawn in.
zooms.name: zoomS

zoomx.description: Position parameter used to define the position of the camera on the world map when chosing the map to spawn in.
zoomx.name: zoomX

zoomy.description: Position parameter used to define the position of the camera on the world map when chosing the map to spawn in.
zoomy.name: zoomY

ROOT-ModInfo.description:
The `mod.info` file, which contains all the information about a mod. It needs to be located alongside the media folder. See the wiki page [Mod structure](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Mod_structure) for more information.

```
📁 MyMod
  📁 <version>
    📁 media
    📄 mod.info
```
ROOT-ModInfo.name: ROOT-ModInfo

author.description: Name of the author(s) of the mod. Multiple authors are often separated by commas but no convention exists.
author.name: author

category.description: Category is used for filtering mods in the in-game ModManager. Known categories are "map", "vehicle", "features", "modpack". Using other terms will not generate a new filter category.
category.name: category

description.description: Description of your mod, which shows up in the mod manager. The description supports [ISRichTextPanel](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/ISRichTextPanel) tags. A translation can be provided in the [Mod.json translation file](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Translation).
description.name: description

icon.description: Image which will be used in the mod manager to put next to the name of the mod in the list of available mods. This image will be small and while you can use a full image size, you do not need it. You can set your poster as the icon too to not ship two images if desired.
icon.name: icon

id.description:
The unique identifier of the mod, used in a mod list of the user or
servers to activate the mod. Make sure to use something unique which isn't shared
between mods. 

**Note:** This is not the same as the [Workshop ID](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Workshop_ID).
id.name: id

incompatible.description:
Mods that cannot be enabled at the same time as this mod. When enabled, the other mods will be unselectable. This mod will also become unselectable if any of the other mods are enabled.

Example:
```
incompatible=theUnwantedMod,theOtherOne
```
incompatible.name: incompatible

loadmodafter.description:
Loads the mod only after the set of mods listed.

Example:
```
loadModAfter=someMod,anotherMod
```
loadmodafter.name: loadModAfter

loadmodbefore.description:
Loads the mod before the set of mods listed.

Example:
```
loadModBefore=someMod,anotherMod
```
loadmodbefore.name: loadModBefore

name.description: The displayed name for your mod in the game's mod manager. A translation can be provided in the [Mod.json translation file](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Translation).
name.name: name

pack.description: Name of pack files that need to be loaded by the game. Notably used for [Texture pack](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Texture_pack) and [Tile pack](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Mapping).
pack.name: pack

poster.description:
Image which will show up in the mod manager as the mod image. Multiple posters can be used to show multiple images, but the first one will be used as the main poster in the mod manager. The rest will be in a list of images of the mod that users can click on to view.

Example:
```
poster=poster.png
poster=showcase.png
poster=flying_chickens.png
poster=credits.png
```

If you have multiple versions of your mod (e.g., 42.12 and 42.13) and don't want to copy your images, you can leave them in the common folder and use the following (but use unique names for these images since it will use the pool of all mods and their images in the common folder):
```
poster=../common/mymodname_poster.png
poster=../common/mymodname_showcase.png
poster=../common/mymodname_flying_chickens.png
poster=../common/mymodname_credits.png
```
poster.name: poster

require.description:
Mods required to run this mod. Multiple mods can be specified separated by commas.

Example:
```
require=theNeededMod,theOtherOne
```
require.name: require

tiledef.description:
Name of the tiledef with its ID that are added by the mod. You can find a community managed list of already used tiledef IDs in [Tiledefs used by mods](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Tiledefs_used_by_mods).

Example:
```
tiledef=Excavation 2112
```

If you upload your mod with a new tiledef ID, you can update the list to reduce the chance of incompatibility with other mods adding tile packs.
tiledef.name: tiledef

url.description: Shows a URL link in the mod manager on the page of your mod for users to click on to open in their internet browser. The parameter appears as "Homepage" in the mod manager. For a list of valid links, see [URL](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/URL).
url.name: url

versionmax.description: The maximum version of the game the mod can be used on. This number needs to be in the format `build.major` at the very least, and not just `build` or it won't work. Example `42.12`.
versionmax.name: versionMax

versionmin.description: The minimum version of the game the mod can be used on. This number needs to be in the format `build.major` at the very least, and not just `build` or it won't work. Example `42.0`.
versionmin.name: versionMin

ROOT-Rules.description:
The `Rules.txt` file is used in the [mapping tools](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Mapping#Mapping_tools) to define new [BMP to TMX](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/BMP_to_TMX) conversion rules. You can store this file anywhere on your computer and you need to reference it in the BMP Tool settings.

A reference image containing the exact pixel colors you need to use for your BMP can be found [here](https://github.com/Unofficial-PZ-Mapping-Discord/B42-Colors/tree/main).
ROOT-Rules.name: ROOT-Rules

version.description: Version of the rules file. Should be 1 for now.
version.name: version

ROOT-SandboxOptions.description:
The root of a sandbox options file. The file should be stored in the following path:
```
📁 media
  📄 sandbox-options.txt
```

You can find more information about sandbox options [here](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Sandbox_options).
ROOT-SandboxOptions.name: ROOT-SandboxOptions

version.description: The version of the handler of the sandbox options. Keep this equal to 1.
version.name: VERSION

ROOT-Scripts.description: The root of a script file. Blocks than need to be in the root of the document should have this as parent.
ROOT-Scripts.name: ROOT-Scripts

ROOT-SpriteModels.description: The `spriteModels.txt` file is used to register [models](https://pz-wiki-modding.github.io/PZ-API-Docs/scripts/model.html) and animations to tiles. This is notably used for radio items as well as doors and ramps.
ROOT-SpriteModels.name: ROOT-SpriteModels

ROOT-TMXconfig.description: The `TMXconfig.txt` file is used to configure the default layers which will be created in the TMX file.
ROOT-TMXconfig.name: ROOT-TMXconfig

revision.description: Revision of the TMXconfig file. Keep it to 11 for now.
revision.name: revision

version.description: Version of the TMXconfig file. Should be 1 for now.
version.name: version

ROOT-TileGeometry.description: The `tileGeometry.txt` file is used to register the tile depth of tiles. The file needs to be located inside the [common/media](https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Mod_structure#Common_and_versioning_folders) folder.
ROOT-TileGeometry.name: ROOT-TileGeometry
